Op. 7055B54 UNDER-ENGINE GUARD - R R

Refitting

Removing

- Fit the rear fuel return pipe.

- Position the return pipe in the housing on the tank passing it between the bodyshell and the actual tank.

- Connect the front return pipe and the rear return pipe to the coupling.

Op. 7055B54 UNDER-ENGINE GUARD - R R

- Lower the lift.

- Working from inside the passenger compartment, connect the rear return pipe to the rapid connector on the pump.

- Fit the protective cover for the submerged pump housing.

- Connect the negative battery terminal.

- Remove the vehicle from the lift.
